reading.action: Floor 2 (cleared): cache the looted pauldron+rivet+sac at the up-stair, then carefully sweep the rest of the cistern for anything useful
reading.result: STRONG SUCCESS (margin 16) — thorough despite weak observance (high roll 15 + careful intent). Found ALL room resources: (1) toppled brazier-stand w/ flint-striker = coaxable FIRE source; (2) coil of rotted rope (~4m, frail) — TAKEN to cache; (3) loose walkway slabs (pry: thrown slab / +1 physDef shield-board); (4) SUNKEN debris under the platform spotted through now-still water — 2nd iron bar (atk 4) + river-stone (thrown) — NOT retrieved (requires submerging, VIT-6 risk, his choice); (5) bracket-spikes = dead end. Item acquired: rotted rope. No affinity event (no heat). No resource cost. Loot cache (pauldron/rivet/sac/rope) staged at the up-stair.
